key: DexNom Runtime, a fork of VIctory for AMD Radeon, tested on a Radeon RX 7900 XTX. It builds on ZSlayerHQ's victory-world-runtime with its own fixes for shaders, texture streaming and GPU memory. PortWatch has seen it running with ray-traced lighting working, the first AMD build on our board to get it. Its picture is the best-rated on our board, though lighting and materials still have problems, and it plays through missions at about 3-4 fps (about 1 fps with ray tracing on), rarely crashing.

key: AvatarManz's fork of VIctory, tuned for speed on an AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX. It brings victory-fork's, DexNom's and Belobug's work together on VIctory and adds its own speed-ups: the game's draw calls translated on eight threads of its own, frames prepared on a separate thread, and textures uploaded on their own queue. PortWatch has verified it: GTA VI runs at about 16 fps on average in game, with sound, as far into the story as the leading builds. Its README measures 13-22 fps indoors and on the first boat mission, and a 41-minute session without a crash.
